title: Binance Will Add Caldera (ERA) on Earn, Buy Crypto, Convert, Margin & Futures
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce that  Caldera (ERA)  will be added to  Binance Simple Earn ,  "Buy Crypto" ,  Binance Convert ,  Binance Margin , and  Binance Futures  at the respective dates and timings listed below. Earn ERA Flexible Products  will be listed on Binance Simple Earn at  2025-07-17 15:30 (UTC)  and will be  available for subscription . Notes: Caldera (ERA) is a project on the Binance HODLer Airdrops program, which rewards BNB holders with token airdrops based on historical snapshots of their BNB Simple Earn asset or BNB On-Chain Yield balances.  Users can subscribe to  BNB Simple Earn Products  (Flexible or Locked Products) or BNB  On-Chain Yield  to automatically enjoy HODLer Airdrops rewards. Buy & Sell Crypto Users can buy  ERA  with  VISA, MasterCard, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Revolut  or buy and sell  ERA  with their  account balances  on the “ Buy Crypto ” page, available within one hour of  ERA  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Convert Users will be able to start trading  ERA  against BTC, USDT, and any other tokens on  Binance Convert  at  zero fees  within one hour of  ERA  being  listed on Binance Spot .  Margin Binance Margin will add  ERA  as a new borrowable asset on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as the  ERA/USDT  and  ERA/USDC  pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin at  2025-07-17 15:30 (UTC). Notes:  Please note that newly listed tokens tend to be volatile; users are encouraged to adopt stringent risk management strategies when trading such tokens. Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Futures Binance Futures will launch the  USDⓈ-M ERA Perpetual Contract  at  2025-07-17 15:30 (UTC) , with up to 75x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M ERA Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below: USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract ERAUSDT Launch Time  2025-07-17 15:30 (UTC) Underlying Asset Caldera (ERA) Settlement Asset USDT Tick Size 0.0001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 75x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the ERAUSDT Perpetual Contract at the time of launch is +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2025-07-17 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-07-17 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-07-18 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2025-07-18 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … The aforementioned perpetual contract will be made available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. For more information on available Futures Copy Trading contracts, please refer to  this FAQ . Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the ERAUSDT Perpetual Contract from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the ERAUSDT Perpetual Contract across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the ERAUSDT Perpetual Contract.  The ERAUSDT Perpetual Contract is subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
